about_the_game:
This demo version includes 9 levels and offers 20-30 minutes of gameplay, giving players a taste of the core mechanics and overall feel of the game.

Leo: The Square is a minimalist 2D platformer that focuses on atmosphere and level design. While the demo does not include the full story, it focuses on gameplay, allowing players to experience the movement, puzzles, and interactions that define the game. The demo also features a carefully crafted soundtrack and sound design, created to perfectly complement the game's atmosphere and visual style.

Key Features of the Demo

  • Immersive atmosphere – Designed to provide a rich visual and auditory experience through minimalist aesthetics and a thoughtful soundtrack.

  • Pure gameplay focus – a full experience of the game's mechanics and level design.

  • 9 engaging levels – Navigate through various obstacles and challenges while experiencing the game's platforming mechanics.

About the Developer

My name is Tim, and I'm developing Leo: The Square entirely on my own, including this demo. This project serves as a rehearsal for the full game, allowing me to refine mechanics, gather feedback, and prepare for the final release. I share my development journey and insights on my YouTube channel.
